chain_words.nuance: to give the main points without detail
to state the key points briefly
to show findings or ideas formally to an audience
to add detail and explanation to an idea
to explain a theory at length and in depth

explanation: These words all describe communicating ideas to an audience, from a brief outline to a thorough, in-depth explanation.

usage_notes.difference: 'Summarize' gives only the key points briefly; 'expound' explains a theory at length and in full depth.
